test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: The compound interest (compounding half yearly) received on Rs. 24000 for 2 years is Rs. 25766.4. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution: Given: Amount = Rs. 49766.4 Principal = Rs. 24000 Time = 2 years Formula used: Amount when interest is compounded half-yearly = P[1 + (R/200)]2T P = Principal
